# ThermalFluctuationComputing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computing paradigm that exploits thermal noise in nanoscale magnetic materials as a computational resource rather than a disturbance. Offers a novel, low-power approach for neuromorphic nodes that can be embedded directly into network interconnects.
